boardKey.APPROVE: The audit recommends adopting it as written when the affected screenplay is drafted. Fits the locked runtime.

proposals.title: The last Relay blanks in Celestine's hand
proposals.placement: S1-86, beat 6, as Celestine finishes writing to Richard.

It never finds anyone: people carry it, as the sewing circle does. 4. It proves nothing about the truth of the message or the sender's goodwill, and it gives no receipt.

Only the city scale is new in Season 1. Before S1-77, gold never binds anyone outside the room.

benefit.narrative: Reconciles the truth document with S1-30 without changing either, and makes S1-77 a step up rather than a contradiction.
benefit.emotional: The audience has seen gold in a child's hand long before the river, so the climax feels earned.
benefit.visual: Gold grows in scale across the season.

risk.note: A reading rule. Production must keep pre-S1-77 gold small and local.
